cases.source:
it.each([
    ['mediumImpact', 'android:long-press'],
    ['selection', 'android:gesture-start'],
    ['success', 'android:confirm'],
    ['error', 'android:reject'],
    ['edgeBump', 'android:clock-tick']
  ] as const)('plays %s as %s', (kind, expected) => {
    platform.OS = 'android'
    playPageHaptic(kind)
    expect(calls).toEqual([expected])
  })

cases.source:
it('names exactly what the shell honours over the bridge', () => {
    // The same list `init.grants.native` gives the page. A name here with nothing behind it is a
    // route the desktop will hand over and the page will find it cannot use.
    expect([...MOBILE_WEB_SHELL_GRANTS]).toEqual([
      'navigate',
      'storage',
      'externalLink',
      'screencastBinary',
      'haptics',
      'externalNavigation',
      'native.clipboard.write',
      'native.clipboard.read',
      'native.media.pick',
      'native.media.read',
      'native.media.release',
      'native.media.name',
      'native.audio.start',
      'native.audio.read',
      'native.audio.stop',
      'native.storage.read'
    ])
  })

cases.title: never reads shell lines as a connection failure
cases.source:
it('never reads shell lines as a connection failure', () => {
    const failed = replay([
      { type: 'gates-changed', gates: gates() },
      { type: 'cache-read', generation: null },
      { type: 'download-failed', cause: { reason: 'connection-lost', hostCode: null } }
    ])
    const report = buildConnectionDiagnosticsReport({
      hostName: 'Desk',
      endpoint: 'ws://192.168.1.2:6768',
      state: 'disconnected',
      reconnectAttempts: 1,
      lastConnectedAt: null,
      platform: 'ios',
      appVersion: '0.0.56',
      bridgeProtocolVersion: 1,
      entries: entries([
        ...failed.lines,
        ...present(stall(replay(DOWNLOAD_OPEN.slice(0, 6)))),
        ...present(stall(replay([]))),
        ...present(bridgeDiagnosticLine({ kind: 'refused', refusal: 'oversized' })),
        frameWithoutHostLine({ clientReady: false, snapshotReady: false })
      ]),
      nowMs: 60_000
    })
    expect(report).toContain(
      'Likely cause: No single failure cause can be determined from the recorded events.'
    )
  })
cases.reason: Actual failed/activation/checking/bridge/frame diagnostics enter the real report analyzer and do not invent a connection cause when disconnected; each helper-present precondition remains explicit.

    const report = buildConnectionDiagnosticsReport({
      hostName: 'Desk',
      endpoint: 'ws://192.168.1.2:6768',

      entries: entries([
        ...failed.lines,
        ...present(stall(replay(DOWNLOAD_OPEN.slice(0, 6)))),
        ...present(stall(replay([]))),
        ...present(bridgeDiagnosticLine({ kind: 'refused', refusal: 'oversized' })),
        frameWithoutHostLine({ clientReady: false, snapshotReady: false })
      ]),
      nowMs: 60_000
    })
    expect(report).toContain(
      'Likely cause: No single failure cause can be determined from the recorded events.'

final_case.title: never reads shell lines as a connection failure
final_case.source:
it('never reads shell lines as a connection failure', () => {
    const failed = replay([
      { type: 'gates-changed', gates: gates() },
      { type: 'cache-read', generation: null },
      { type: 'download-failed', cause: { reason: 'connection-lost', hostCode: null } }
    ])
    const report = buildConnectionDiagnosticsReport({
      hostName: 'Desk',
      endpoint: 'ws://192.168.1.2:6768',
      state: 'disconnected',
      reconnectAttempts: 1,
      lastConnectedAt: null,
      platform: 'ios',
      appVersion: '0.0.56',
      bridgeProtocolVersion: 1,
      entries: entries([
        ...failed.lines,
        ...present(stall(replay(DOWNLOAD_OPEN.slice(0, 6)))),
        ...present(stall(replay([]))),
        ...present(bridgeDiagnosticLine({ kind: 'refused', refusal: 'oversized' })),
        frameWithoutHostLine({ clientReady: false, snapshotReady: false })
      ]),
      nowMs: 60_000
    })
    expect(report).toContain(
      'Likely cause: No single failure cause can be determined from the recorded events.'
    )
  })

cases.source:
it('leaves an earlier connection failure as the likely cause', () => {
    const timeout: ConnectionLogEntry = {
      id: 'timeout',
      ts: 500,
      level: 'error',
      code: 'connect-timeout',
      message: 'WebSocket connect timeout'
    }
    const report = buildConnectionDiagnosticsReport({
      hostName: 'Desk',
      endpoint: 'ws://192.168.1.2:6768',
      state: 'disconnected',
      reconnectAttempts: 1,
      lastConnectedAt: null,
      platform: 'ios',
      appVersion: '0.0.56',
      bridgeProtocolVersion: 1,
      entries: [timeout, ...entries(replay(DOWNLOAD_OPEN).lines)],
      nowMs: 60_000
    })
    expect(report).toContain(
      'Likely cause: The saved direct endpoint did not answer before the connection timeout.'
    )
  })

cases.title: masks absolute paths wherever they start, including spaced and Windows ones
cases.source:
it('masks absolute paths wherever they start, including spaced and Windows ones', () => {
    expect(maskUserText("open '/var/mobile/Containers/a.db' failed")).toBe("open '[path]' failed")
    expect(maskUserText('at f (/Users/me/secret.js:1)')).toBe('at f ([path])')
    expect(maskUserText('bad `/Users/me/x.js` here')).toBe('bad `[path]` here')
    expect(maskUserText('path="/home/bob/x" [/Users/bob/y]')).toBe('path="[path]" [[path]]')
    expect(maskUserText('read C:\\Users\\bob\\x.txt and \\\\srv\\share\\y')).toBe(
      'read [path] and [path]'
    )
    expect(maskUserText('key:~/notes.txt')).toBe('key:[path]')
    expect(maskUserText('open C:\\Users\\John Doe\\proj\\x.ts failed')).toBe('open [path] failed')
    expect(maskUserText('at /Users/Jane Q/My Proj/a.js and more')).toBe('at [path] and more')
    expect(maskUserText('a,/Users/x/y')).toBe('a,[path]')
    expect(maskUserText('Cannot read properties of undefined')).toBe(
      'Cannot read properties of undefined'
    )
  })
cases.reason: Ten explicit probes exercise actual masking of POSIX/file-like, quoted, backtick, drive, UNC, home, spaced and comma-prefixed paths plus unchanged plain text. Preserve each exact input/output pair; this does not test native path APIs.
